description: This file defines a React component for managing input parameters in an asset details page. It includes functions for listing, creating, editing, and displaying input parameters with associated UI elements such as modals, forms, data tables, and actions. It interacts with backend API endpoints for CRUD operations on input parameters, UOMs, and reporting programs, and manages state for form inputs, loading indicators, validation, and user feedback.

methods.name: toSelectOptions
methods.description: Filters an array of rows to return only active items (where isActive is true or undefined).

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Loads the list of input parameters and updates related states, handling selection logic.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Prepares the form and opens the modal for creating a new input parameter.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Prepares the form with existing data and opens the modal for editing an input parameter.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Validates form data and performs create or update API calls for input parameters, handles success and error feedback.
